name: Scrambled Eggs with Spinach and Whole Grain Toast
ingredients: 2 eggs, 1 cup fresh spinach, 1 slice whole grain bread, 1 tsp olive oil, salt and pepper to taste
recipe:
1. Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
2. Add spinach and cook until wilted.
3. Beat eggs in a bowl, then pour into the pan with spinach.
4. Cook until eggs are scrambled to your desired consistency.
5. Toast the whole grain bread and serve with the scrambled eggs.

name: Greek Yogurt with Berries and Honey
ingredients: 1 cup Greek yogurt, 1/2 cup mixed berries, 1 tbsp honey
recipe:
1. Place Greek yogurt in a bowl.
2. Top with mixed berries.
3. Drizzle with honey.

name: Overnight Oats with Almond Butter and Banana
ingredients: 1/2 cup rolled oats, 1/2 cup almond milk, 1 tbsp almond butter, 1/2 banana (sliced), 1 tsp chia seeds
recipe:
1. In a jar, combine oats, almond milk, and chia seeds.
2. Stir well, then refrigerate overnight.
3. In the morning, top with almond butter and banana slices before serving.

name: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
ingredients: 1 slice whole grain bread, 1/2 avocado, 1 egg, salt, pepper, red pepper flakes
recipe:
1. Toast the bread.
2. Mash the avocado and spread it on the toast.
3. Poach the egg and place it on top of the avocado toast.
4. Season with salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes.

name: Protein Pancakes
ingredients: 1 banana, 2 eggs, 1/4 cup protein powder, 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp coconut oil
recipe:
1. In a bowl, mash the banana.
2. Mix in the eggs, protein powder, and baking powder until smooth.
3. Heat coconut oil in a pan over medium heat.
4. Pour batter into the pan to form pancakes and cook until bubbles form on the surface, then flip and cook until golden brown.

name: Smoothie with Whey Protein
ingredients: 1 banana, 1 scoop whey protein, 1 cup almond milk, 1 tbsp peanut butter, 1/2 cup spinach
recipe:
1. Combine all ingredients in a blender.
2. Blend until smooth.
3. Pour into a glass and serve.

name: Chia Pudding
ingredients: 3 tbsp chia seeds, 1 cup almond milk, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 tbsp honey, 1/4 cup berries
recipe:
1. In a jar, combine chia seeds, almond milk, vanilla extract, and honey.
2. Stir well and refrigerate overnight.
3. In the morning, top with berries before serving.

name: Oatmeal with Whey Protein and Berries
ingredients: 1/2 cup rolled oats, 1 cup water, 1 scoop whey protein, 1/2 cup berries, 1 tsp cinnamon
recipe:
1. Cook oats with water according to package instructions.
2. Stir in whey protein and cinnamon.
3. Top with berries before serving.

name: Egg White Omelette with Veggies
ingredients: 4 egg whites, 1/4 cup bell peppers (chopped), 1/4 cup spinach, 1/4 cup mushrooms (sliced), 1 tsp olive oil, salt, pepper
recipe:
1. Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
2. Add bell peppers, spinach, and mushrooms, cook until tender.
3. Pour egg whites into the pan and cook until set.
4. Season with salt and pepper before serving.

name: Quinoa Breakfast Bowl
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked quinoa, 1/2 cup almond milk, 1/4 cup berries, 1 tbsp almonds (sliced), 1 tsp honey
recipe:
1. In a bowl, combine cooked quinoa and almond milk.
2. Top with berries, sliced almonds, and honey.

name: Cottage Cheese with Pineapple
ingredients: 1 cup cottage cheese, 1/2 cup pineapple chunks
recipe:
1. In a bowl, combine cottage cheese and pineapple chunks.
2. Mix well before serving.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie
ingredients: 1 banana, 1 tbsp peanut butter, 1 cup almond milk, 1 scoop whey protein, 1 tsp honey
recipe:
1. Combine all ingredients in a blender.
2. Blend until smooth.
3. Pour into a glass and serve.

name: Spinach and Feta Omelette
ingredients: 2 eggs, 1/4 cup spinach (chopped), 2 tbsp feta cheese, 1 tsp olive oil, salt, pepper
recipe:
1. Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
2. Add spinach and cook until wilted.
3. Beat eggs in a bowl, then pour into the pan.
4. Cook until eggs are set, then add feta cheese.
5. Fold omelette in half before serving.

name: Blueberry Protein Muffins
ingredients: 1 cup oats, 1/2 cup Greek yogurt, 1 scoop whey protein, 1/2 cup blueberries, 1 egg, 1/4 cup almond milk, 1 tsp baking powder
recipe:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
2. In a bowl, mix oats, Greek yogurt, whey protein, egg, almond milk, and baking powder.
3. Fold in blueberries.
4. Pour batter into muffin tins and bake for 20-25 minutes.

name: Breakfast Burrito
ingredients: 2 eggs, 1/4 cup black beans, 1/4 cup salsa, 1/4 avocado (sliced), 1 whole grain tortilla
recipe:
1. Scramble the eggs in a pan.
2. Warm the tortilla in a separate pan.
3. Place scrambled eggs, black beans, salsa, and avocado slices in the tortilla.
4. Roll up the tortilla and serve.

name: Protein French Toast
ingredients: 2 slices whole grain bread, 1 egg, 1 scoop whey protein, 1/4 cup almond milk, 1/2 tsp cinnamon, 1 tsp coconut oil
recipe:
1. In a bowl, whisk together egg, whey protein, almond milk, and cinnamon.
2. Dip bread slices in the mixture, coating both sides.
3. Heat coconut oil in a pan over medium heat.
4. Cook the bread until golden brown on both sides.

name: Smoked Salmon and Avocado Toast
ingredients: 1 slice whole grain bread, 1/4 avocado, 2 oz smoked salmon, 1 tsp lemon juice, salt, pepper
recipe:
1. Toast the bread.
2. Mash the avocado and spread it on the toast.
3. Top with smoked salmon and drizzle with lemon juice.
4. Season with salt and pepper before serving.

name: Almond Joy Smoothie
ingredients: 1 cup almond milk, 1 banana, 1 scoop chocolate whey protein, 1 tbsp almond butter, 1 tbsp shredded coconut
recipe:
1. Combine all ingredients in a blender.
2. Blend until smooth.
3. Pour into a glass and serve.

name: Strawberry Banana Smoothie
ingredients: 1 banana, 1/2 cup strawberries, 1 cup almond milk, 1 scoop whey protein, 1 tsp honey
recipe:
1. Combine all ingredients in a blender.
2. Blend until smooth.
3. Pour into a glass and serve.

name: Egg Muffins
ingredients: 6 eggs, 1/4 cup bell peppers (chopped), 1/4 cup spinach, 1/4 cup tomatoes (chopped), salt, pepper
recipe:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
2. In a bowl, beat the eggs and mix in the bell peppers, spinach, and tomatoes.
3. Pour the mixture into a greased muffin tin.
4. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the eggs are set.

name: Chocolate Protein Smoothie
ingredients: 1 banana, 1 cup almond milk, 1 scoop chocolate whey protein, 1 tbsp almond butter
recipe:
1. Combine all ingredients in a blender.
2. Blend until smooth.
3. Pour into a glass and serve.

name: Pumpkin Spice Protein Pancakes

recipe:

2. Heat coconut oil in a pan over medium heat.

name: Breakfast Quinoa

recipe:

name: Peanut Butter and Jelly Overnight Oats

recipe:

recipe:

recipe:
